Miniature scale & conversion math

Gaming labels describe eye level, and ratio labels are defined from full height, but my conversion pairs compare eye-level equivalents on the same 175cm human (eyes at 160cm). On that basis, 28mm to 32mm is 114.3% and 32mm to 28mm is 87.5%. Every other conversion uses the same formula: target divided by source, times 100.

This is the foundation of everything else on STLACCESS. Once you know which height a scale refers to and which baseline it was derived from, the slicer percentage stops being a guess. The guides below work from first principles and show the arithmetic, not just the answer.
